verdict.rationale: Socket platform and upgrade-path commitments are a fair question for a desktop CPU, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack names the 285K's socket or states any multi-generation support commitment. The spec-sheet items cover cache, clocks, ECC, vPro and AI frameworks, and the community items cover memory stability and performance, none of which is about platform longevity.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can upgrade the CPU without replacing the platform — a documented socket with a stated multi-generation support commitment
